systems.platform: a digital platform for its management, to be set up by the minister of local affairs
systems.owner: ministre chargé des Affaires locales, through the Unité de gestion du Registre; Centre national de l'informatique for technical and operational tasks
systems.tiers: holds Tunisian nationals entered in the civil status registers of the communes and of diplomatic missions and consulates, and naturalised persons; civil status officers must update its data within seven days of an entry; its data has probative force until proved otherwise and may stand in for the paper registers

systems.system: base de données de l'état civil
systems.country_label: base de données de l'état civil
systems.owner: Unité de gestion du Registre de l'identifiant unique citoyen, ministère chargé des affaires locales (article 24)
systems.tiers: named as managed by the Unit together with the Register; not described
named in article 4: agents who deliver civil status acts may not disclose the identifier on it; not otherwise described

note: The decree of 15 May 2020 governs the citizen identifier and its register, an identity system fed from the civil status registers; it names a civil status database and platform without describing how an office makes the record, so no fact.
